slug: 2026-05-20 Transforming lives in Benin a unique identification system

facts.fact: The World Bank says more than 7.7 million people have their NPI as of the end of May 2025, about 52% of the 14.8 million population (divided by the population given, not stated in the document).
The World Bank says nearly 99% of Benin's population is now biometrically enrolled.
